prompt: I'm a chiropractor and want to build an email list with ClickFunnels-style lead funnels. Based on the Lead Funnels Swipe File book, what are the parts of a lead funnel and what lead magnet and hook should I create?
assertions: Names the five parts: lead magnet, landing page, thank you page, sales page, follow-up funnel
Recommends a curiosity 'hook' and a pain-focused lead magnet (e.g., 'The # Biggest Mistakes...' formula / Myron Golden tip)
Says landing pages need a headline, image of the lead magnet, and opt-in form, kept simple
Says the thank you page should deliver the lead magnet and offer one next step (product, webinar, or podcast/blog), with no bait-and-switch
Mentions 'the money is in the list' and/or building a relationship via follow-up and daily publishing
